授業概要
Course Start Date: October 8th
Classroom: B-104
This course focuses on analyzing urban land use efficiency. Students will engage in practical analysis of Fukuoka city, learning techniques to evaluate urban land use efficiency based on accessibility to essential facilities. The course will culminate in studying various urban land use scenarios derived from our findings.
"Urban plans assist communities in assessing their current state and envisioning their future. Cities are in a constant state of flux, each changing in unique ways. Some cities experience population growth, while others face decline. Transportation methods also vary, with some cities relying on public transit and others on private vehicles. Urban planning and design evaluate the strengths and weaknesses of a community in the present and strategize for future improvements. A thorough understanding of a community's functioning and its potential changes leads to better urban plans and designs for the future."

This course allows students to analyze urban land use efficiency. It is a practical course in which students analyze the city of Fukuoka and learn techniques for evaluating urban land use efficiency based on accessibility to facilities that everyone needs.
Finally, we will study various urban land use scenarios based on our own findings.
